subject: Draft MAP + Week0 slide outline for LumenHealth pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + Week0 slide outline for LumenHealth pilot

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a working MAP template and a very small Week0 slide outline to get alignment on stakeholders and the first 30 days. The goal is a compact pilot that proves inference throughput and integration with your data plane while keeping time-to-value low.

What I shared:
- MAP_template_master_v1.docx (attached) — canonical MAP with milestones, owners, acceptance criteria.
- Week0_onboarding_slides_v1.pptx (attached) — quick slide skeleton for the kickoff (roles, access, success metrics).
- Live copies: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C4dLumenMAP/edit and https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/7G8h9I0LumenWeek0Slides/edit (you should have edit access)

Ask: can you co-edit the MAP and add the internal stakeholders for security and procurement? Two specific items I want to confirm this week:
1) Target pilot timeline: we were thinking 30 days from kickoff with week-by-week acceptance gates — does that work?
2) Procurement PO / contact for SOW/PO — can you introduce procurement or share the contact for the purchase order?

I copied Jasmine (Solutions) and Marissa (SE) so they can add technical owners and acceptance gates. If you prefer, we can lock the doc and run a brief co-edit session Thursday morning.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_template_master_v1.docx (docx), Week0_onboarding_slides_v1.pptx (pptx)

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@lumenhealth.com>, procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + Week0 slide outline for LumenHealth pilot

Thanks Jordan — this looks like a great starting point. I gave you edit access to the Google Doc and added a quick note in the timeline section. A couple of asks from our side: 

- Please add an explicit security review milestone (IT sign-off + list of artifacts) — I started a sheet (Security_Reqs_Lumen.xlsx) and attached it to this thread for reference.
- Procurement lead is Sam Lee (cc'd) — Sam can handle PO/SOW routing. Sam, can you confirm our standard PO window so we can pencil dates in the MAP?
- I also added Dr. Priya Natarajan and our infra lead (it-infra@lumenhealth.com) as technical stakeholders in the doc; can you add those names to the Week0 slides?

On timeline: 30-day pilot sounds reasonable if we define the acceptance gates tightly. We should plan a kickoff the week of Dec 20 so our infra team can be present.

Happy to co-edit Thursday morning — I suggested 9:00am PT in the doc comments.

Best,
Erin Walsh
Head of AI Partnerships
LumenHealth
erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, Sam Lee <sam.lee@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + Week0 slide outline for LumenHealth pilot

Erin — thanks for the quick turnaround and for adding priorities. I updated the live MAP (version v2) with the security milestone and added Sam as procurement owner. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C4dLumenMAP/edit (DOC now has a redlined v2).

What I changed:
- Week 0: kickoff logistics + access checklist (added Priya Natarajan and it-infra@lumenhealth.com)
- Week 1: baseline perf validation (throughput + latency) owners: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
- Security review milestone: artifact list + acceptance criteria (refer to Security_Reqs_Lumen.xlsx)
- Procurement milestones: PO submission and SOW signoff (Sam Lee owner)

Internal note to Jasmine/Marissa: can you each review the acceptance criteria for Week 1 and the security milestone by EOD Thursday so we can lock the MAP before the co-edit session? Also please annotate the deck with the technical access slide (who needs SSH/key access, service account setup).

HubSpot: I've attached the updated MAP and linked the deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (deal LUM-2026-0423).

If everyone is aligned, let's set the kickoff for Mon, Dec 20 at 10:00am PT — Erin, will that work for your infra folks?

Jordan

Attachments: MAP_LumenHealth_v2.gdoc (live), Week0_onboarding_slides_v2.pptx (pptx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + Week0 slide outline for LumenHealth pilot

Thanks Jordan — I reviewed the MAP_v2 and left a couple inline comments in the doc (Week 1 acceptance criteria and the data transfer checklist). Confirming owners:

- Week 1 perf validation: Jasmine (jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com)
- Week 2 integration + connectivity: Marissa (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com) — I will lead the runbook and be on the kickoff.
- Security artifacts: Erin / Lumen security team to validate; we'll provide sample logs and an audit script.

Timeline note: I think 30 days is feasible with tight gates — recommend we add a contingency week in the MAP for any vendor-side integration delays. I added that as a soft Week 5 buffer.

I can join the Dec 20 kickoff at 10:00am PT. Jasmine — can you confirm availability?

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
